newsitem.title: USA: Oakley to buy Essilor unit.
newsitem.headline: Oakley to buy Essilor unit.

text.p: Oakley Inc said on Tuesday it agreed to an option to buy the non-prescription lens production unit of Gentex Optics, the U.S. unit of France's Essilor International SA.
The company said in a statement that it, Essilor and Gentex had entered into a letter of intent for the purchase. Financial terms of the option agreement were not disclosed.
Gentex Optics produces advanced-technology polycarbonate lenses and is Oakley's sole supplier of polycarbonate lenses.
The agreement is subject to the execution of definitive documentation and the approval of both companies' boards of directors.

The option to purchase is not exercisable by Oakley until the expiration of a four-year licence to be granted to Oakley by Essilor and Gentex. Under the licence, Oakley will receive the exclusive right to purchase from Gentex and Essilor decentered sunglass lenses and a new scratch-resistant coating developed by Essilor for use with such lenses.
In return, Oakley will be committed to purchase all its lens requirements from Gentex.
